# Feature extraction with position features (vectorized where possible)
def add_position_features(df):
    """Add token-level positional features"""
    df = df.copy()

    # Get sentence lengths
    sentence_counts = df.groupby("sentence_id").size().reset_index(name="sentence_len")

    # Position features per sentence
    pos_indices = df.groupby("sentence_id", group_keys=False)["token_id"].rank(
        method="first"
    )
    pos_rank = pos_indices.astype(int) - 1

    # First position in sentence
    first_pos = df.loc[
        df.groupby("sentence_id").apply(lambda x: x.index[0]), "token_id"
    ]
    df["pos_first"] = pos_indices == 0
    df["pos_first_val"] = pos_rank.where(pos_indices == 0, np.nan)

        df.groupby("sentence_id").apply(lambda x: x.index[-1]), "token_id"
    ]
    df["pos_last"] = pos_indices == pos_rank.max(axis=0)
    df["pos_last_val"] = pos_rank.where(pos_indices == pos_rank.max(axis=0), np.nan)

    return df
